items.title: Record PD-2 isolated enforce subsystem decision
items.context: Update docs/requirements/decisions/authority-client-role.md to say ordinary koala remains workflow thin client while only future koala authority enforce may become a headless authority runner.
items.userSees: Terminal/docs reviewer can quote: "ordinary koala remains a workflow thin client; koala authority enforce is a future isolated headless runner path; Python authority remains the receipt authority; Mac Runner remains an execution plane."

happy.desc: PD-2 section names ordinary koala workflow client, koala authority enforce headless runner client, Python authority receipt authority, and Mac Runner separately.

edge.desc: The doc states PD-2 does not replace Mac Runner and does not make existing local/shadow evidence authoritative.

adversarial.desc: The doc explicitly forbids treating transport accepted or local JSON as verified authority receipt evidence.

verificationEvidence.note: PD-2 section names ordinary koala workflow client, koala authority enforce headless runner, Python authority receipt authority, and Mac Runner execution plane
PD-2 explicitly states it does not replace Mac Runner and does not make existing local/shadow evidence authoritative
PD-2 explicitly forbids treating transport accepted or local JSON as verified authority receipt evidence

items.title: Harden mechanical boundary classification for future enforce namespace
items.context: Extend the existing authority boundary tests so normal CLI submissions remain thin-client even if future enforce subsystem terms are present in docs, and only explicit signed envelope plus verified receipt can classify as L2+.
items.userSees: Test output includes the exact line: "authority boundary smoke passed" and the evidence matrix proves accepted true without verified receipt stays thin-client transport accepted, while complete signed envelope plus verified receipt is the only L2+ case.

happy.desc: A fixture with complete run bindings, provider metadata, digests, envelope signature, and verified receipt classifies as receipt-backed L2+.

edge.desc: A submission using the existing workflow CLI authority transport path with accepted true but no verified receipt stays thin-client transport accepted.

adversarial.desc: A same producer/verifier run or missing receipt signature cannot classify as L2+ even if labeled enforce in prose.

verificationEvidence.note: New caseEnforceNamespaceDocWordingDoesNotPromoteWorkflowSubmission covers enforce-namespace wording guard; existing happy path proves complete signed envelope + verified receipt is required for L2+
caseEnforceAcceptedTransportNotReceipt proves accepted=true without verified receipt stays thin-client-transport-accepted
caseAdversarialSameRunCollapsedVerifier proves same producer/verifier run cannot be L2+ even with receiptVerified=true

items.title: Reserve enforce subsystem command boundary without implementing runner behavior
items.context: Add or document a command/catalog boundary for the future koala authority enforce namespace so Milestone 1 can add policy discovery without silently wiring production evidence submission.
items.userSees: Docs show: "Milestone 1 may add policy discovery only; Milestone 2+ owns actor keys, jobs, envelopes, and receipts; Milestone 0 introduces no evidence-submitting command."

happy.desc: The boundary artifact names Milestone 1 as policy discovery only and Milestone 2+ as actor/job/evidence work.

edge.desc: Existing authority off/shadow/enforce transport behavior remains unchanged for workflow evidence handlers.

adversarial.desc: No command introduced by this story can submit production L2+ evidence or bypass the existing receipt boundary.

verificationEvidence.note: koala authority enforce command boundary section names Milestone 1 as policy discovery only, Milestone 2+ as actor/job/evidence work
Existing authority off/shadow/enforce transport behavior unchanged; test passes confirming no regressions
No command introduced by this story can submit production L2+ evidence; boundary section explicitly forbids bypassing receipt boundary

items.title: Create Milestone 0 validation record and next-story handoff
items.context: Capture verification evidence and a concise handoff that says what Milestone 1 may implement next and what remains forbidden until later milestones.
items.userSees: Story summary says: "Milestone 0 completed boundary docs and smoke tests only; next story is Milestone 1 policy discovery; actor key, job claim, provider execution, full envelope, and receipt verification remain unimplemented."

happy.desc: Validation evidence includes the boundary smoke tests and authority client smoke tests.

edge.desc: The handoff preserves PD-2 constraints when future Milestone 1 starts policy discovery.

adversarial.desc: The story outcome does not claim actor key, job claim, provider execution, full envelope, or receipt verification are implemented.
